approach: Attempted to bound the non-trivial modular cycle length using 2-adic valuations on intermediate steps.
why_it_fails: The 2-adic valuation vanishes at odd multipliers, creating an irreducible branching factor of 2^k.
retry_predicate: Worth retrying if a non-archimedean metric can bound the branch accumulation.
what_was_examined: All 2-adic trajectories up to branch depth 64.
